kind: Data comparison: PDF dataset vs the v23 registry on staging. Analysis only: the PDF was not rebuilt and its text was not re-read.
method: Each dataset item (country x role) is matched to its registry selection (country, slot). The TARA role maps to the registry slot STABILIZER.
SUCROSE: the registry selectionKind must be GLOBAL_PI.
Every other role compares the dataset against the registry:
- the EAN digits (leading zeros ignored) against product.identity.gtin;
TARA: the 'From abroad' tag must match offerChannel == IMPORT.
Every link shown in the PDF must appear among the URLs of the sourceIds of that selection or its product.
Script: compare_dataset_registry.py (same folder). It is read-only and writes nothing.

results.tara_channel_matches_tag: 75/75 (IMPORT 72 -> From abroad; LOCAL 2; 'LOCAL — USA B2B' 1 -> B2B)

brand_label_differences.decision: No change. The decisive value is the country row in 04_POKRYCIE_PR ('Marka'), which the PDF already shows. The registry keeps one brand label per deduplicated product; an identical EAN does not justify renaming.

limitations: The PDF's data file was compared, not the PDF. PDF text, layout, readability and live links were not re-checked today. The only PDF-level check is the historical 13/13 validation of 2026-09-12, run on the same PDF sha256.
The registry is a separate derivation of v23 (PR #319). Agreement shows the two derivations agree; it does not re-validate the workbook.
Fat %, dextrose form, shop codes, notes and the SMP/DEXTROSE 'From abroad' tags were not compared in this run.
No link was opened. Availability, prices and delivery were not checked.
The 12 brand differences are reported, not changed; the country row in the approved table is decisive.
